questions.question_text: Amir invests his $1500 in an account which pays compound interest. The interest rate is 3% per year for 5 years, after which it is 2% per year. Find the value of Amir's investment at the end of 11 years.
Bibi invests her $1500 in an account which pays r% per year simple interest. At the end of 11 years, the investment is worth $1962. Calculate the value of r.
Caitlyn invests her $1500 in an account which pays t% per year compound interest. At the end of 11 years, the investment is worth $1968.13. Calculate the value of t.
A transformation maps triangle A onto triangle B. Triangle A is congruent to triangle B. Tick all the possible transformations it could be.
A transformation maps triangle C onto triangle D. The angles of triangle C are the same as the corresponding angles of triangle D. Tick all the possible transformations it could be.
A transformation maps triangle E onto triangle F. Triangle F has a larger area than triangle E. Tick all the possible transformations it could be.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle P onto triangle Q.
Stretch triangle P with the x-axis invariant and scale factor 2.
Complete the scatter diagram. The first five points have been plotted for you.
What type of correlation is shown in the scatter diagram?
Find the equation of the regression line for h in terms of d.
Use your regression line to estimate the height of a plant that was planted 28 days ago.
A plant was planted 140 days ago. Explain why you should not use the equation of the regression line to estimate the height of this plant.
When x represents the number of emails Essa receives each day, find the median,
When x represents the number of emails Essa receives each day, find the range,
When x represents the number of emails Essa receives each day, find the upper quartile,

When x represents the height of a seedling, correct to the nearest centimetre, explain why you cannot work out the range of the heights.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x).
Write down the equation of each asymptote parallel to the y-axis.
Write down the coordinates of the local minimum.
Find the range of values of x for which the gradient of f(x) is negative.
Solve f(x) = -x.
Draw a cumulative frequency curve to show these results.
Use your curve to find the interquartile range.
Apples with a mass below 80 g are used to make drinks. Find the percentage of the 300 apples that are used to make drinks.
The nth term of a sequence is \frac{n(n+1)(2n+1)}{6}. Find the first three terms of this sequence.
For the sequence 11, 8, 5, 2: find the next two terms, and find an expression for the nth term.
For the sequence -2, -2, 0, 4, 10, 18: find the next two terms, and find an expression for the nth term.
For the sequence 3, 5, 9, 17, 33: find the next two terms, and find an expression for the nth term.
Calculate the volume of the prism.
Calculate the total surface area of the prism.
Calculate the length AF.
Calculate angle FAC.
The volume of a mathematically similar prism is 445.5 cm3. Calculate the total surface area of this similar prism.
Use substitution to show that the x-coordinates of the points A and B satisfy the equation 10x^2 + 6x - 15 = 0.
Solve the equation 10x^2 + 6x - 15 = 0 to find the coordinates of the points A and B. Show your working and give your answers correct to 2 decimal places.
Find f(g(1)).
Solve g(x) = 25.
Write down f(f^{-1}(x)).
Show that angle ABC = 107.2° correct to 1 decimal place.
The bearing of B from A is 305°. Using the sine rule, show that angle BAC = 44.4° correct to 1 decimal place.
Find the bearing of C from A.
A ship leaves A at 22 50 and sails at a constant speed of 24 km/h towards C. Calculate the time, correct to the nearest minute, when the ship is nearest to B.
For each Venn diagram, shade the given set.
Use set language to describe the shaded set.
Two of the 40 people are chosen at random. Find the probability that they both watch exactly 2 of the 3 programmes.
Two of the people who watch programme P are chosen at random. Find the probability that one of them watches both other programmes and one watches just one of the other programmes.
Three of the 40 people are chosen at random. Find the probability that two of them watch only programme Q and one of them watches only programme R.
Rearrange y = \frac{ax+b}{ex+f} to make x the subject.
Write down the amplitude and the period of f(x).
